rationale: AMLAS Version 1.1 enumerates six lifecycle stages from safety-assurance scoping through deployment and describes their relation to system safety requirements. Its introduction and using-this-document section expressly limit the guidance to the ML component, state it should not be used in isolation, and state a primary focus on offline supervised learning. The claim keeps the absence of regulator acceptance and end-to-end approval explicit.

limitations: AMLAS is research guidance, not a regulator-issued means of compliance or product authorization.
The methodology itself cannot close system-level risk, acceptable-risk thresholds, or a particular vehicle/aircraft safety case.
